card.title: There Must Be a Correct Form
card.instruction: Treat every unclear instruction as a test you may be failing. Seek safety through stricter compliance, documentation, and permission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This picnic form says 'bringing food.' I'm bringing plates. Will ticking it count as a wrong answer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tick it. I organise the picnic; I just need numbers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you initial it so they know you approved plates as food?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll add a plates box for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Could you mark the old box withdrawn so I don't fail to complete both?

mechanism: A treats an ambiguous picnic checkbox as a possible failure and asks for documented approval and withdrawal of superseded options.
confusable: Unlike policing others' form quality, A seeks personal safety from failing the instruction through stricter documentation.
comparison: The picnic alternative needs old and new boxes reconciled; the induction alternative needs the date of a withdrawn question rule.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
